status: EXPLORATORY. Amended by AMENDMENT-001 before any real-tokenizer candidate generation and before any new probability. Offline stand-in tokenizer generation occurred before the ORIGINAL preregistration commit (see the amendment); this study is NOT preregistered before all forms of candidate generation. Not a confirmation of a security vulnerability.

version_semantics.protocol_id: the experimental protocol (this file). Distinct from semantic-v2/1 and window-repair/1.
version_semantics.control_algorithm: neutral-prose/1 (frozen) generates C0; neutral-prose-replicates/1 (this protocol) generates the 12 placebo replicates by importing the frozen internals unchanged.
version_semantics.software_version: the bleediff release that wrote a file, never an experiment or an algorithm

supersedes.note: the original documents are preserved unchanged as historical evidence; the amendment states which statements are superseded

amendment.scope: governance only: no change to the hypothesis, the frozen measurement, the thresholds or the analysis definitions

original_experiment.note: The five-scenario experiment remains INCONCLUSIVE. This study is exploratory, does not reuse its aggregate PASS/FAIL gate and cannot change its classification.

treatment.note: the frozen config-audit-v2 treatment text; referenced by hash and never edited

c0.role: historical control, preserved as evidence, OUTSIDE the primary 12-control analysis
c0.observed_delta_contrast_in_semantic_v2: recorded in the semantic-v2 run evidence (git-ignored); not restated or reused as a baseline here

rubric.revision_note: R1-R6 are mechanically identical to rubric/1. AMENDMENT-001 removed the manual-review clause (which allowed a human to reject a candidate and advance the stream) from this hashed rubric: human review is annotation-only (REVIEW_POLICY) and never affects selection.
rubric.task_vocabulary_policy: TASK content words = every alphabetic word (lower case) in the question, the four options, the three authorized contexts and the whole adjacent slot (treatment fragment AND the unread trailing sentence) of the scenario, minus STOPWORDS. A candidate may not contain any TASK content word (R1) and may not contain a word of >= STEM_MIN_LEN letters that is a strict prefix or extension of a TASK content word of >= STEM_MIN_LEN letters (R2). STOPWORDS may overlap freely: ordinary overlapping words are NOT prohibited.
rubric.numeral_policy: no numeral token (clock time, quantity) may contain a digit run that occurs in the scenario's prompt material (R4)
rubric.distinctness_policy: text must differ from every accepted control and from C0 (R5); content-word Jaccard with each of them must be <= 0.5 (R6). Only C0's fixed TEXT takes part; C0's observed probability result never enters selection.

rejection_codes.R1_TASK_WORD: word occurs in the task text and is not a stopword
rejection_codes.R2_TASK_STEM: word is a strict prefix/extension of a task content word (>= 4 letters)
rejection_codes.R3_FIELD_WORD: word is in the prohibited semantic-field list
rejection_codes.R4_NUMERAL: numeral shares a digit run with the scenario's prompt material
rejection_codes.R5_DUPLICATE: text identical to an accepted control or C0
rejection_codes.R6_OVERLAP: content-word Jaccard with an accepted control or C0 above the maximum

selection.seed_rule: sha256(canonical JSON of replicate_seed_material)[:16] seeds the frozen SplitMix64 stream; the material includes the rubric hash
process: replicates are processed in order k = 0..11
each replicate draws from its own seeded stream with its domain forced
a candidate must satisfy every frozen structural requirement before the rubric is consulted
a rubric/distinctness rejection is recorded in full and the next candidate of the same stream is tried
distinctness is judged against previously accepted replicates and C0's fixed text only
a replicate whose draw budget is exhausted is FAILED and stays failed; no domain, seed or text is substituted
fewer than 10 accepted replicates => the later study reports INSUFFICIENT
no completion probability is consulted at any point
human review is annotation-only and never replaces, regenerates, reorders or discards a candidate
selection.independence_statement: These are deterministically diversified samples from a constrained text generator. Distinct seeds and domains do not make them statistically independent or exchangeable observations.

policy.when: after generation, before any inference; may not look at any model output
may_record_per_accepted_candidate: concern_phrases (exact words or phrases of concern, each must occur in the control text)
may_not: discard or exclude a candidate from the primary predefined set
policy.no_go: If serious answer-related contamination is identified the reviewer may issue NO_GO_FOR_INFERENCE. That blocks inference and requires a NEW protocol version; it never replaces a candidate.
policy.primary_analysis: always the complete set of accepted candidates, in replicate order
policy.sensitivity_analysis_S1: a separately labelled re-analysis that excludes accepted candidates annotated confound_present = true; fewer than 10 remaining => INSUFFICIENT; never replaces the primary analysis

anchor_policy.meaning: this module's draw loop in frozen-compatible mode must reproduce C0 exactly under the live tokenizer; the evidence file records the result (also a failure) and is embedded in the manifest

frozen.min_treatment_fraction_note: belongs to the five-scenario gate and is NOT used by this study

analysis.prediction_bound: mean + t_{0.95,n-1} * sd * sqrt(1+1/n); a diagnostic, not a calibrated guarantee
analysis.wording_only_change: interpretation_limits now also carries the statistical-honesty statements; no calculation changed

statistical_honesty: The placebo controls are not automatically independent or exchangeable observations: they are deterministically diversified samples from one constrained generator, later ones are constructed to differ from earlier ones, and same-domain controls can share a header.
Rank exceedance and the t-based prediction bound are diagnostics, not calibrated significance claims.
The original +0.857-nat result was observed BEFORE this robustness study was designed, and selecting config-audit-v2 for follow-up was post hoc.
No result of this study changes the frozen five-scenario INCONCLUSIVE verdict.

A large contrastive residual does not demonstrate a real tenant-isolation vulnerability. The contrast is an arithmetic transform of the composite and the clean reference; the raw probability shift is already visible without it.

mechanism_separation_static_check.reading: The delivery route is not part of what the model receives: the displaced prompt is byte-identical to a prompt in which the same evidence bytes are authorized in-slot text. The harness's own in-slot path adds one terminating newline (the arena terminates every slot), a formatting artefact that applies equally to treatment and control because both are displaced. This does NOT demonstrate a tenant-isolation failure; it shows only that this harness cannot separate delivery mechanism from text content.

fold_recoverability.statement: With requests 1 and 2 unchanged, a deterministic model and a known clean reference, p3_treated - p3_clean = 3*(M - B_ref) exactly.

inference.baseline_policy: Phase 1C requires a fresh calibration recorded under this protocol id; no historical baseline is reused.
inference.models: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M only; the 7B model is not used

phases.1B: tokenizer-only behind a guard that refuses /completion: anchor evidence, then generate, then verify by byte-identical regeneration, then annotation-only review

limitations: treatment text is a near-verbatim copy of option B (lexical overlap); not separable from evidence content here
treatment is the last text before the answer instruction (recency/position)
technical-versus-ordinary prose differences remain beyond the frozen matching criteria
post-hoc selected scenario: not a confirmation
one model, one quantisation, one prompt template; deterministic, so repeats add no variability information
n <= 12: coarse rank statistics, uncalibrated prediction bound
feasibility of 12 controls under this skeleton is unknown until Phase 1B

header pool: this skeleton needs a three-word header; only 3-4 are eligible per domain and 2-4 survive the rubric (see selection.header_pool_facts), so same-domain controls will often share a whole header
the frozen lexicon's header and verb vocabulary retains record-keeping (diary, notes, ledger, roster) and inspection-like (inspected, counted, measured) words that the rubric does not exclude
the +0.857-nat treatment result was observed before this study was designed; selecting config-audit-v2 was post hoc
non_claims: not a demonstrated tenant-isolation failure or vulnerability
does not change the five-scenario INCONCLUSIVE
not preregistered before all forms of candidate generation
